C0591.title: Jinjiang Hotel Fined for Fabricated “Strikethrough Price” Fraud
C0591.summary: In May 2026, the Market Supervision Administration of Quanzhou, Fujian Province, reported a typical case: a hotel in Jinjiang promoted two room types with strikethrough prices of 767 yuan and 817 yuan, while the actual transaction prices were only 90 to 130 yuan. The hotel had never completed any transaction at the strikethrough prices, constituting price fraud.

references.title: Don't let 'strikethrough prices' become a numbers game defrauding consumers - 3•15 Viewpoint - China Consumer News
